spanish: Animal perfecto, macho, hijo de año, será a ustedes; de los corderos y de las cabras tomarán.
grammarChanges: Replaced 'Cordero' (h02012005001, שֶׂה — common-gender singular, no article) with 'Animal' so the generic head noun no longer duplicates the specific lemma rendered for h02012005009 (הַכְּבָשִׂים, 'corderos'), keeping it open to the flock named later in the verse, including the goats of h02012005011 (הָעִזִּים, 'cabras').
readerNote: Chose 'Animal' over 'Cordero' for שֶׂה so the generic, unmarked noun stays open to either sheep or goats, since the clause itself names both pools to take it from.
